alert_get_stats.name: alert_get_stats
alert_get_stats.description: Alert statistics (counts by severity, by source, ack latency).

alert_list.name: alert_list
alert_list.description: All alerts (with optional filters). Companion to alert_list_unacknowledged (Phase 1) which is unack-only.

alert_list_unacknowledged.name: alert_list_unacknowledged
alert_list_unacknowledged.description: List all unacknowledged alerts. Use alert_acknowledge / alert_resolve via direct HTTP for state changes (those remain out of Phase 1 scope).

backtest_signals.name: backtest_signals
backtest_signals.description: Active backtest signals (active_signals, var_95/99, sharpe_short/long, drawdown_pct).

calendar_events.name: calendar_events
calendar_events.description: Industry / market calendar events (ETF rebalances, MSCI, revenue, shareholder meetings, window dressing, holidays). 14-day forward window.

capital_flow_daily.name: capital_flow_daily
capital_flow_daily.description: Full daily Taiwan stock market capital flow report: 七維錢潮雷達（3+2+2 分層）— three official actor forces (foreign / institutional / dealer, T86 first-party), two behavioral proxies (government / retail) and two leading / cross-market signals (foreign futures OI / TSM ADR). Each dimension carries role, source, unit and availability flags; the resonance model only votes on the official_actor tier.

capital_flow_summary.name: capital_flow_summary
capital_flow_summary.description: Condensed 七維錢潮雷達（3+2+2 分層） summary suitable for a quick Taiwan market briefing; actor consensus is derived from the three official actor dimensions only.

channel_health.name: channel_health
channel_health.description: Channel-level health summary (channel_id, status, updated_at) for the data ingestion pipeline.

control_approve_recommendation.name: control_approve_recommendation
control_approve_recommendation.description: Status of an approve-recommendation override (read-only state inspection; actual approval is admin-only).

control_get_active_overrides.name: control_get_active_overrides
control_get_active_overrides.description: Currently active control overrides (paused agents, sector bans, weight overrides).

control_get_audit_log.name: control_get_audit_log
control_get_audit_log.description: Control override audit log (which agents were paused/banned, by which operator). Read-only by design.

control_pause_agent.name: control_pause_agent
control_pause_agent.description: Pause a specific agent (suspend its recommendations). Side-effect: persists in control store. Requires ATLAS_API_KEY.

operator.description: operator identifier (defaults to MCP server's authenticated identity)

control_reject_recommendation.name: control_reject_recommendation
control_reject_recommendation.description: Status of a reject-recommendation override (read-only state inspection).

control_resume_agent.name: control_resume_agent
control_resume_agent.description: Resume a previously-paused agent. Side-effect: removes pause override. Requires ATLAS_API_KEY.

operator.description: operator identifier (defaults to MCP server's authenticated identity)

control_sector_ban.name: control_sector_ban
control_sector_ban.description: Ban a sector from new positions. Side-effect: applies sector override. Requires ATLAS_API_KEY.

banned.description: true to apply ban, false to lift existing ban

crossmarket_get_correlation.name: crossmarket_get_correlation
crossmarket_get_correlation.description: Latest cross-market correlation matrix (Taiwan sector vs US indices).

crossmarket_get_status.name: crossmarket_get_status
crossmarket_get_status.description: Cross-market data feed status (US indices source, freshness, error count).

crossmarket_get_us_indices.name: crossmarket_get_us_indices
crossmarket_get_us_indices.description: Latest US index and tech stock snapshots — live-fetched from Yahoo Finance (real-time freshness). Includes S&P 500, NASDAQ, Dow Jones, SOX, NVDA, AAPL, MSFT, TSM ADR. Prefer this over macro_get_snapshot_latest when you need the most current data.

daily_report.name: daily_report
daily_report.description: 回傳最新每日市場報告 JSON，含全球資金總開關、台股七維錢潮雷達（3+2+2 分層）分解、事件日曆、策略訊號與風險提示。適合 LLM agent 每日晨報摘要生成。

data_get_channel_detail.name: data_get_channel_detail
data_get_channel_detail.description: Detail for a single data channel by name (latency, error rate, last fetch).

data_get_channels.name: data_get_channels
data_get_channels.description: List all data channels (fugle, twse, yahoo, finmind, internal) with status.

data_get_field_contract.name: data_get_field_contract
data_get_field_contract.description: Field contract schema introspection (field types, optionality) for a model.

data_get_quality.name: data_get_quality
data_get_quality.description: Data quality metrics (gaps, stale symbols, completeness by source).

detector_registry_list.name: detector_registry_list
detector_registry_list.description: All 24 template trigger detectors registered in the narrative.DetectorRegistry with current enable/disable state. Use to inspect which detectors are active or to verify registry wiring.

event_calendar.name: event_calendar
event_calendar.description: Upcoming Taiwan market events calendar (ETF rebalances, MSCI adjustments, revenue announcements, window dressing, holidays). 14-day forward look.

event_flow_prediction.name: event_flow_prediction
event_flow_prediction.description: 5-day event-driven capital flow prediction. Maps upcoming events (ETF rebalances, revenue, MSCI, etc.) to predicted capital flow directions by day with confidence scores.

experiment_diff.name: experiment_diff
experiment_diff.description: Diff between a candidate experiment and the baseline (config + metrics comparison).

experiment_history.name: experiment_history
experiment_history.description: Historical list of experiments (judge results, promotions, reverts).

experiment_judge.name: experiment_judge
experiment_judge.description: Trigger LLM judge scoring for a candidate experiment vs the baseline. Side-effect: writes to experiment history.

experiment_promote.name: experiment_promote
experiment_promote.description: Promote a candidate experiment to baseline. Side-effect: rewrites baseline policy. Requires ATLAS_API_KEY.

experiment_revert.name: experiment_revert
experiment_revert.description: Revert a candidate experiment (cancel promotion / restore prior baseline). Side-effect: rewrites baseline policy. Requires ATLAS_API_KEY.

explain_market_move.name: explain_market_move
explain_market_move.description: 提供繁體中文的「為什麼漲跌」市場解說。回傳今日台股漲跌原因，包含大盤表現、資金面、國際環境與風險提示。適合散戶快速理解市場變動的背後因素。LLM agent（如 Hermes、OpenClaw）可用此工具為用戶生成白話市場解讀。

get_recommendations.name: get_recommendations
get_recommendations.description: Tier-appropriate portfolio allocation recommendations (growth, momentum, defensive, all_weather, value). Returns market light overview for free tier. These are portfolio-level strategy IDs — for market signal detectors (e.g. foreign-3day-inflow, margin-balance-extreme), use strategy_list_active.

industry_sector_list.name: industry_sector_list
industry_sector_list.description: List all Taiwan-sector canonical identifiers with their Traditional-Chinese labels and representative stock symbols. Returns the full 20-sector taxonomy used by atlas-go. No input parameters required.

industry_sector_lookup.name: industry_sector_lookup
industry_sector_lookup.description: Look up a Taiwan sector by stock symbol (e.g. 2330) or sector name/alias (canonical ID, full Chinese label, or legacy alias like 半導體, 金融, semiconductor). Returns the canonical identifier, Chinese display label, and representative stock symbols. Provide at least one of: symbol, sector.

sector.description: Sector canonical ID, full Chinese label, or legacy alias, e.g. semiconductor or 半導體

symbol.description: Taiwan stock symbol without .TW suffix, e.g. 2330

llm_get_cost.name: llm_get_cost
llm_get_cost.description: LLM cost snapshot — recent spend, by model, by capability.

llm_get_health.name: llm_get_health
llm_get_health.description: LLM router health — provider status (DeepSeek, MiniMax/M3), circuit-breaker, fallback chain.

macro_get_capital_flow_latest.name: macro_get_capital_flow_latest
macro_get_capital_flow_latest.description: Latest foreign / institutional / retail capital flow snapshot.

macro_get_ingest_status.name: macro_get_ingest_status
macro_get_ingest_status.description: Channel ingestion status (last fetch times, error counts). Use to diagnose data freshness.

macro_get_snapshot_history.name: macro_get_snapshot_history
macro_get_snapshot_history.description: Macro snapshot history over the last N days (default 30, max 365).

macro_get_snapshot_latest.name: macro_get_snapshot_latest
macro_get_snapshot_latest.description: Return the latest macro data snapshot — from on-disk cache (5-min refresh cycle, may lag real-time data). Use crossmarket_get_us_indices for real-time US stock/index data. Covers: foreign capital, regime, chips, US indices, tech stocks, FX, commodities.

macro_get_stress_index_current.name: macro_get_stress_index_current
macro_get_stress_index_current.description: Current Taiwan stress index (TRJ narrative). Use to assess market risk appetite.

macro_get_stress_index_history.name: macro_get_stress_index_history
macro_get_stress_index_history.description: Stress index history over the last N days.

mcp_anomaly_ack.name: mcp_anomaly_ack
mcp_anomaly_ack.description: Acknowledge an anomaly alert via the atlas alert store.

mcp_anomaly_get_recent.name: mcp_anomaly_get_recent
mcp_anomaly_get_recent.description: List the most recent anomaly events detected by the MCP observability subsystem.

limit.description: how many events to return; default 10, max 100

mcp_elicit_user.name: mcp_elicit_user
mcp_elicit_user.description: Ask the connected MCP client to elicit input from the user (form or url). Requires client elicitation capability.

message.description: message to present to the user

mode.description: elicitation mode: form or url; inferred from other fields if empty

schema.description: JSON schema for form mode (top-level properties only)

url.description: URL to present for url mode

mcp_get_call_stats.name: mcp_get_call_stats
mcp_get_call_stats.description: Return call statistics for the recent window: total calls, error count, p50 latency, and per-tool breakdown. window_minutes defaults to 60 and is capped at 1440 (24h).

window_minutes.description: query window in minutes; default 60, max 1440

mcp_get_session_topology.name: mcp_get_session_topology
mcp_get_session_topology.description: Return the agent_id to tool call matrix for the recent window. window_minutes defaults to 60 and is capped at 1440 (24h). Empty agent_id falls back to 'anonymous'.

window_minutes.description: query window in minutes; default 60, max 1440

mcp_get_tenant_usage.name: mcp_get_tenant_usage
mcp_get_tenant_usage.description: Return per-tenant usage stats for the recent window: total calls, error count, tool count. window_minutes defaults to 60 and is capped at 1440 (24h).

window_minutes.description: query window in minutes; default 60, max 1440

mcp_get_top_slow_tools.name: mcp_get_top_slow_tools
mcp_get_top_slow_tools.description: Return the slowest tools by p50 latency for the recent window. window_minutes defaults to 60 and is capped at 1440 (24h). limit defaults to 5 and is capped at 20.

limit.description: number of slowest tools to return; default 5, max 20

window_minutes.description: query window in minutes; default 60, max 1440

mcp_quickstart.name: mcp_quickstart
mcp_quickstart.description: 一站式市場速覽：回傳最新宏觀快照、當前推薦策略、壓力指數與資金流向摘要、今日事件。外部 AI 首次接入時調用此 tool 即可取得完整操作脈絡，無需多次調用。

mcp_roots_list.name: mcp_roots_list
mcp_roots_list.description: List the file:// roots declared by the connected MCP client.

mcp_roots_read_file.name: mcp_roots_read_file
mcp_roots_read_file.description: Read a file under a declared file:// root. Read-only, path-traversal hardened, and audited.

path.description: file:// URI to read, must be under a declared root

mcp_sample_llm.name: mcp_sample_llm
mcp_sample_llm.description: Request the connected MCP client to sample a message from its LLM. Requires client sampling capability.

messages.description: conversation messages to send to the client LLM

tools.description: optional tools available to the model

narrative_get_bundle.name: narrative_get_bundle
narrative_get_bundle.description: Compiled 'briefing bundle' (events + chains + templates) suitable for an LLM agent's morning summary.

narrative_get_chains.name: narrative_get_chains
narrative_get_chains.description: Current narrative chains (cause-effect graphs) for the latest detected event.

narrative_get_events.name: narrative_get_events
narrative_get_events.description: Latest narrative events (regime shifts, capital flows, macro shocks).

narrative_get_models.name: narrative_get_models
narrative_get_models.description: Active narrative models (regime detector, flow forecaster, etc.).

narrative_get_templates.name: narrative_get_templates
narrative_get_templates.description: Cause-effect templates available to the narrative model registry.

narrative_stress_index_thresholds.name: narrative_stress_index_thresholds
narrative_stress_index_thresholds.description: Configurable thresholds for the stress index (used by the narrative engine to flag regime shifts).

parameters_get.name: parameters_get
parameters_get.description: Current parameters (flat key → type map, e.g. {\"alert.sla_warning_sec\":\"int\"}). Mirrors dashboard parameters page.

parameters_get_audit_log.name: parameters_get_audit_log
parameters_get_audit_log.description: Parameter change audit log (who/when/why). Empty list when no changes recorded yet.

parameters_get_categories.name: parameters_get_categories
parameters_get_categories.description: Available parameter categories with id/name/description (darwinian, factor, optimizer, sizing, health, garch, experiment, baseline, ...).

parameters_get_metadata.name: parameters_get_metadata
parameters_get_metadata.description: Parameters with full provenance metadata (value, rationale, source, citation, last_calibrated).

parameters_get_snapshots.name: parameters_get_snapshots
parameters_get_snapshots.description: Historical parameter snapshots (default last 20 days, max 365).

days.description: how many snapshots back; default 20, max 365

prism_get_training_results.name: prism_get_training_results
prism_get_training_results.description: Latest PRISM cohort training results (config + metrics per cohort).

regime_get_history.name: regime_get_history
regime_get_history.description: Return the market regime history for the last N days. Regimes are RISK_ON / RISK_OFF / NEUTRAL / TRANSITIONAL.

days.description: how many days back; default 30, max 365

report_get_daily_summary.name: report_get_daily_summary
report_get_daily_summary.description: Daily summary report (text or structured) suitable for an LLM agent's morning briefing.

report_get_export_link.name: report_get_export_link
report_get_export_link.description: Signed export link for a report variant (expires after a short TTL).

report_get_performance.name: report_get_performance
report_get_performance.description: Performance report (period-configurable) with attribution and risk-adjusted metrics.

report_get_tax_snapshot.name: report_get_tax_snapshot
report_get_tax_snapshot.description: Tax-relevant snapshot (realized gains, dividend totals, foreign tax).

risk_exposure.name: risk_exposure
risk_exposure.description: Current portfolio risk exposure: var_95/99, cvar_95, max_drawdown_pct, cash_ratio, sector/factor/concentration breakdown.

risk_get_calibration.name: risk_get_calibration
risk_get_calibration.description: Risk model calibration metrics (predicted vs realized VaR).

risk_get_commentary.name: risk_get_commentary
risk_get_commentary.description: Latest narrative risk commentary (auto-generated from the risk engine).

risk_get_drawdown.name: risk_get_drawdown
risk_get_drawdown.description: Current drawdown, peak drawdown, recovery stats.

risk_get_metrics.name: risk_get_metrics
risk_get_metrics.description: Aggregate risk metrics (current regime risk, VaR estimate, drawdown, exposure).

scheduler_get_status.name: scheduler_get_status
scheduler_get_status.description: Background scheduler status: which tasks ran, when, last result. Read-only overview of the dispatcher state.

sector_allocation_plan.name: sector_allocation_plan
sector_allocation_plan.description: Latest persisted simulation sector-allocation snapshot, including target/current/delta, provenance, fallback status, mutation receipt, and next-session consumption evidence.

stock_get_chips.name: stock_get_chips
stock_get_chips.description: Return institutional investor flow (foreign, domestic fund, dealer net buy/sell) for a symbol on a given trading day.

date.description: trading day in YYYYMMDD; defaults to the most recent trading day with data

stock_get_fundamentals.name: stock_get_fundamentals
stock_get_fundamentals.description: Return fundamental metrics (PE, PB, PS, dividend yield, sector) for a symbol.

stock_get_quote.name: stock_get_quote
stock_get_quote.description: Return the latest intraday quote for a Taiwan stock symbol. Requires FUGLE_API_KEY to be configured on the atlas server.

stock_get_technical.name: stock_get_technical
stock_get_technical.description: Return simple technical indicators (SMA20, SMA50, RSI14) for a symbol over the last N days.

days.description: number of trading days to include; default 90, max 365

strategy_get.name: strategy_get
strategy_get.description: Fetch a single strategy by id (returns full config + state metadata).

strategy_get_attribution.name: strategy_get_attribution
strategy_get_attribution.description: Performance attribution for a strategy over the requested window.

strategy_get_layers.name: strategy_get_layers
strategy_get_layers.description: All strategy layers (L1-L5) currently configured in the system.

strategy_get_summary.name: strategy_get_summary
strategy_get_summary.description: Compact summary of a strategy (hit rate, Sharpe, drawdown, regime behavior).

strategy_list_active.name: strategy_list_active
strategy_list_active.description: List the market technique set (L1-L5 signal detectors) currently active in production. Includes detectors like foreign-3day-inflow, margin-balance-extreme — these are trading signal rules, NOT portfolio allocation strategies. For portfolio strategies (growth, momentum, defensive), use get_recommendations.

strategy_ranker.name: strategy_ranker
strategy_ranker.description: Return the current active market techniques ranked by performance with free/registered/premium tier labels. These are signal detectors (e.g. foreign-3day-inflow, margin-balance-extreme), NOT portfolio allocation strategies — see get_recommendations for portfolio strategies.

synergy_get_darwinian_status.name: synergy_get_darwinian_status
synergy_get_darwinian_status.description: Current Darwinian weight state (which strategies are being promoted/demoted, current weight delta).

synergy_get_darwinian_trend.name: synergy_get_darwinian_trend
synergy_get_darwinian_trend.description: Historical Darwinian weight trend per strategy (last N days).

synergy_get_l2_4_schedule.name: synergy_get_l2_4_schedule
synergy_get_l2_4_schedule.description: L2.4 observation window schedule (current state, next boundary).

system_get_circuit_breaker.name: system_get_circuit_breaker
system_get_circuit_breaker.description: Circuit-breaker state per external call site.

system_get_data_pipeline.name: system_get_data_pipeline
system_get_data_pipeline.description: Data pipeline state (which channels are flowing, latency, lag).

system_get_health.name: system_get_health
system_get_health.description: Return overall system health status (per docs/workflow-map.md WA-606).

system_get_maturity.name: system_get_maturity
system_get_maturity.description: Maturity ratings per module (S/E/X/U per docs/specs convention).

system_get_metrics.name: system_get_metrics
system_get_metrics.description: Live system metrics (request rate, error rate, circuit-breaker state).

system_get_metrics_trend.name: system_get_metrics_trend
system_get_metrics_trend.description: System metrics trend over a recent window (per-minute aggregates).

system_get_thresholds.name: system_get_thresholds
system_get_thresholds.description: Configured SLO thresholds (latency, error rate, saturation).

taiwan_stress_index.name: taiwan_stress_index
taiwan_stress_index.description: Taiwan market stress index (TRJ narrative) — score, regime, components by source. Use for risk appetite assessment.

task_get.name: task_get
task_get.description: Single task by id (status, progress, last result).

task_get_events.name: task_get_events
task_get_events.description: Event stream of a single task (ordered lifecycle events).

template_detector_status.name: template_detector_status
template_detector_status.description: Recent template trigger detector scan results from ledger. Returns the most recent DetectionResult rows (newest first), each with theme, severity, confidence, detected_at, source, and scan_batch_id. limit param defaults to 100.

limit.description: max number of recent scans to return; default 100 if omitted or 0

trace_get_agent_observatory.name: trace_get_agent_observatory
trace_get_agent_observatory.description: Current agent activity observatory (which agents are active, what they're working on).

trace_get_decision_chain.name: trace_get_decision_chain
trace_get_decision_chain.description: Decision chain for a symbol (full causal trace from macro → sector → agent recommendation).

trace_get_reasoning.name: trace_get_reasoning
trace_get_reasoning.description: Reasoning trace (RAG/CoT steps) for a recent recommendation.

session_id.description: optional session id; defaults to the most recent session

trace_get_sim_latest.name: trace_get_sim_latest
trace_get_sim_latest.description: Latest simulation reasoning trace (most recent agent run).

universe_get_session_detail.name: universe_get_session_detail
universe_get_session_detail.description: Per-strategy drill-down for one session (full recommendation outcomes + summary).

universe_get_sessions.name: universe_get_sessions
universe_get_sessions.description: Recent simulation sessions (id, date, status, top_strategies).

universe_get_universe_overlap.name: universe_get_universe_overlap
universe_get_universe_overlap.description: Universe overlap analysis across recent simulation sessions.
